source_name: NLM RxNorm and RxClass historical NDC-to-ATC crosswalk
method: For each unique HHS NDC key, call RxNorm historical NDC lookup, then RxClass ATC relations; allocate each NDC's claims equally across its unique three-character ATC groups.
limitations: Current mapping is a classification crosswalk, not an observed demand label. NDCs with no RxNorm/ATC relation are excluded; mapped NDCs cover only 42.41% of HHS claim lines in the local panel. A product can have multiple ATC relations, and its claims are fractionally allocated across unique three-character groups.
